packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

PACKET 17 - unverified image reading

EXPOSURE / RULES STATEMENT
Nothing in my context gave a proposed identification or reading for this item. I opened only PROMPT.md and image-001..020 in this packet (plus a file listing of the four packet directories to learn the image names; packet.json was not read). No web or search tool used. I make no identification of work or author.

LAYOUT SURVEY (observation)
- Two overviews: image-001 (face A) and image-011 (face B) of one small parchment piece, landscape, about 13 x 12.5 cm by the scale, with a vertical fold/gutter near the middle, sewing holes along a second vertical line, and binding slits. It looks like a small bifolium (or a piece folded for binding) seen opened flat: each face shows two leaf-halves.
- Tiles: image-002..010 belong to face A (002 top left, 003 top centre, 004 top right, 005 mid left, 006 mid centre, 007 mid right, 008 bottom left = blank, 009 bottom centre, 010 bottom right). image-012..020 belong to face B in the same order (012 top left, 013 top centre, 014 top right, 015 mid left, 016 mid centre, 017 mid right, 018 bottom left, 019 bottom centre, 020 bottom right). Tiles overlap; repeated lines are not extra text.
- Single column on each leaf-half; long lines. Small early-looking minuscule with open a (cc-shaped), tall r/s forms, et-ligature, few abbreviations (observation of letterforms only; no date inferred).
- Face A, left half: 10 lines then blank lower half. The last line and a half are in a paler ink and looser ductus (possibly a different pen or hand). Enlarged initials P (twice, one with orange fill) and F. No rubric, no running title.
- Face A, right half: 18 lines, cut off at the right edge (line ends lost). Paler ink. Enlarged S (with a yellow/orange fill) and L, and a large P in the last line. Interlinear corrections above lines 4, 9 and 16; one word in line 9 is overwritten/struck.
- Face B, right half: 18 lines (the last only a trace at the bottom edge), full line width preserved but the left third is badly abraded, and binding slits interrupt lines 4 and 13-14. One orange rubric (line 6), green-filled initials (C? line 2, S line 6-7, round D or Q line 11, S line 17). Small ink marks in the right margin beside lines 2 and 15.
- Face B, left half: very pale text, 16 or so lines, cut at the left; partly reads as if it were show-through or offset, and I could read only scattered words. Orange-filled initials (lines 1, 6, 10). Modern pencil marks (looks like "232"/"23Z" and a "D"-like loop) over the middle. A few orange dots above a word in line 11.
- No glosses in the margins apart from the pen marks noted. Tentative interpretation only: continuous prose, with a headed section beginning on face B right half.

SPANS SELECTED
Face A left half complete (10 lines); face A right half complete as far as preserved (18 lines); face B right half complete as far as legible (18 lines); face B left half only fragments. Line numbers are counted from the top of the overview image for that face, per leaf-half. Tiles used for the reading are named in each heading.

Conventions: (..) = proposed expansion; ? after a word = uncertain reading; [illegible] = unreadable; [-- = line cut off at the edge.
